2015.chapter_name: Not in NCERT Chapter List (Reading Section - Unseen Passage)
2015.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2015.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2015.context: Much of the information we have today about Chimpanzees comes from the ground breaking, long-term research of the great conservationist. Jane Goodall. Jane Goodall was born in London (England), on April 3, 1934. On her second birthday, her father gave her a toy Chimpanzee named Jubilee. From an early age, Jane was fascinated by animals and animal stories. By the age of 10, she was talking about going to Africa to live among the animals there. At the time, in the early 1940, this was a tradical idea because women did not go to Africa by themselves. Once in Kenya, she met Dr. Louis Leakey, paleontologist and anthropologist. He was impressed with her through knowledge of Africa and its wildlife, and hired her to assist him and his wife on a fossil-hunting expendition to Olduvai Gorge. Dr. Leakey soon realized that Jane was the perfect person to complete a study he had been planning for some time. They begain a study of a group of Chimpanzees who were living on the shores of Lake Tanganyika in Kenya. Jane feced many challenges as she began her work. For the first time the Chimpanzees did not accept her but little by little she was able to enter their world.

sub_questions.1: The information about chimpanzees comes from the ground breaking, long-term research of the great conservationist-"Jane Goodall"
sub_questions.2: She (Jane Goodall) got as her second Birthday gift, a toy chimpanzee named "Jubilee", from her father.
sub_questions.3: She assisted Dr. Louis Leakey on a fossil-hunting expedition to 'Olduvai Gorge. Her aim was to go to Africa and to live among the animals there because she was fascinated by animals and animal stories.

anuprashna.1: चिंपांजी के बारे में जानकारी महान संरक्षणवादी - "जेन गुडॉल" के अभूतपूर्व, दीर्घकालिक शोध से आती है।
anuprashna.2: उसे (जेन गुडॉल) अपने दूसरे जन्मदिन के उपहार के रूप में अपने पिता से "जुबली" नाम का एक खिलौना चिंपांजी मिला।
anuprashna.3: उन्होंने ओल्डुवई गॉर्ज के जीवाश्म-शिकार अभियान में डॉ. लुई लीकी की सहायता की। उनका लक्ष्य अफ्रीका जाना और वहां जानवरों के बीच रहना था क्योंकि वह जानवरों और जानवरों की कहानियों से आकर्षित थीं।

2015.chapter_name: Not in NCERT Chapter List (Reading Section - Unseen Passage)
2015.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2015.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2015.context: For many people who live in cities, parks are an important part of the landscape. They provide a place for people to relax and play sports, as well as a refuge from the often harsh environment of a city. What people often overlook is that parks also provide considerable environmental benefits. One benefit of parks is the plants absorb carbon dioxide-a key pollutant-and emit oxygen which humans need to one study, an acre of trees can absorb the same amount of carbon dioxide that a typical car emits in 11,000 miles of driving. Parks also make cities cooler. Scientists have long noted what it called the Urban Heat Island Effect; building materials such as metal, concrete and asphalt, absorb much more of the sun's heat and release it much more quickly than organic surfaces like trees and grass. Because city landscapes contain so much of these building materials, cities are usually warmer than the surrounding rural areas. Parks and other green spaces help to mitigate the Urban Head Island Effect.

sub_questions.1: What benefits do parks provide city dwellers?
sub_questions.2: Explain one scientific benefit of parks.
sub_questions.3: What is the Heat Island Effect?
sub_questions.4: Find the word in the passage which means the same as 'to take in'.

anuprashna.1: पार्क शहरवासियों को क्या लाभ प्रदान करते हैं?
anuprashna.2: पार्कों के एक वैज्ञानिक लाभ की व्याख्या करें।
anuprashna.4: गद्यांश में वह शब्द ढूँढ़ें जिसका अर्थ 'to take in' (सोखना) के समान है।

2016.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2016.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2016.context: Discipline is the necessity of life. A man without discipline can achieve nothing worth-while in life. Discipline is a very important condition of progress, stability and strength. Discipline is necessary in every walk of human life. Without discipline there will be disorder and lawlessness. In a civilized society we cannot live without having some regard for the welfare of others. Respect for authority is the basis of discipline. Children must obey their parents. In schools and colleges there must be discipline. Otherwise education will suffer. We find evidence of discipline all around us, even in the world of nature and the world of animals. Discipline costs nothing but it wins a lot Discipline helps us to safeguard our interests and retains us from misusing our liberty.

sub_questions.1: What must be have if we want to achieve something in life?
sub_questions.2: What will the condition of the world be if there is not discipline?
sub_questions.3: Where should society begin to inculcate discipline among its citizens?
sub_questions.4: Mention two important factors for having a disciplined society.

anuprashna.2: यदि अनुशासन न हो तो विश्व की स्थिति क्या होगी?
anuprashna.3: समाज को अपने नागरिकों में अनुशासन पैदा करना कहाँ से शुरू करना चाहिए?

2016.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2016.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2016.context: The Kaurava's maternal uncle. Shakuni was adept at gambling which was very popular in those days in the society of big people. Duryodhana invited Yadhishthira to play the game. The latter being a pure hearted and simple person was quite inexperienced in it Dice after dice was cast with the result that Yadhishthira lost his entire kingdom and his wife Draupadi as well. At this the evil hearted Duhshashana, a younger brother of Duryodhana, dragged her to the assembly hall and began to pull off her sari presence of her husbands and the large number of courtiers. At this hour of peril Draupadi closed her eyes and stod praying to Lord Krishna with folded hands to protect her modesty. Lord Krishna at once came to her rescue. Duhsahashana went on pulling off the sari for hours and still he was not able to come to the end of Draupadi's sari.

sub_questions.2: What was the purpose to invite Yudhishthira?
sub_questions.4: What did Draupadi do at the hour of peril?

anuprashna.2: युधिष्ठिर को आमंत्रित करने का उद्देश्य क्या था?
anuprashna.4: संकट की घड़ी में द्रौपदी ने क्या किया?

For healthy hair, we must eat a balanced diet with lots of green vegetables, fresh fruits and cereals, it we follow a healthy regime of yoga, we can enjoy healthy hair as it slows down the process of graying and ageing.

Animals that eat both plants and flesh are called omnivorous like the bears.

2020.prashna: कविता को ध्यान से पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:

A very hungry mouse who said,
"I' ll do just what I please!"
Snuck into a house one night
And sxtole a chunk of cheese
He scamperred down the passageway
And thinking that was that,
Was very unprepared to see
The shadow of a cat.

sub_questions.3: What was he not prepared to see?

Insufficient, small,
I feel when people look at me
They don't see me at all.
I feel that all my beauty's lost
On cold, indifferent eyes
And offering what I want to give
Would only be unwise
But then a friend will greet me
And my inner life will bloom
It only takes but one kind word
To sweep away the gloom!

2021.context: Historians say, "Ashoka became one of the greatest emperors of the world". He was the King of Magadha. He fought a number of battles and defeated kings of many states. Once he attacked Kalinga. To conquer Kalinga proved to be a difficulty task to him. Thousands of innocent people were killed. The blood of innocent people touched Ashoka's heart. He gave up fighting and adopted Buddhism. Later he did much for the spread of Buddhism and welfare of the public.

sub_questions.ii: What did the historians say about him?
sub_questions.iii: What proved to be a difficult task for him?

2021.question: OR Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: अथवा निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2021.context: Sports and games make our bodies strong, prevent us form getting too fat, and keep us healthy. They give us valuable practice in making eyes, brain and muscles work together. In tennis, our eyes see the ball coming, judge its speed and direction, and pass the information on to the brain. The brain then has to decide what to do, and it sends orders to the muscles, of the arms, legs and so on, so that the ball is met and hit back where it ought to go. All, this must happen with very great speed, and only those who, have had a lot of practice at tennis can carry out this complicated chain of events successfully. For those who work with their brain most of the day, the practice of such skills is especially useful.

sub_questions.i: What do games and sports do?
sub_questions.ii: What is the function of the eyes?
sub_questions.iii: When do the muscles of the arms and legs react?
sub_questions.iv: For whom is the practice of tennis especially useful?

anuprashna.iii: हाथों और पैरों की मांसपेशियां कब प्रतिक्रिया करती हैं?
anuprashna.iv: टेनिस का अभ्यास किसके लिए विशेष रूप रूप से उपयोगी है?

2021.question: Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2021.context: The water of river Yamuna in Delhi has become lifeless. The river's water quality is most polluted and has received 'E' grade. This is the lowest grade which indicates the severity of pollution in water. Some fifty years ago, the water of the Yamuna was clear and clean. Many water plants such as weed, algae and shrubs grew in the water. These plants were also the main source of food for aquatic creatures. But what we find now are red worms, which live in the most unhygienic and polluted water.

sub_questions.i: How is the water of river Yamuna at present?
sub_questions.iii: What grew in the water when the Yamuna was clean?
sub_questions.iv: What do we find now in its water?

anuprashna.i: वर्तमान में यमुना नदी का पानी कैसा है?
anuprashna.iii: जब यमुना साफ थी तब पानी में क्या उगता था?
anuprashna.iv: अब इसके पानी में हमें क्या मिलता है?

2021.question: OR Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: अथवा निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2021.context: Language is a wonderful gift given to man. No animal possess this gift, but they have their own way of expressing themselves. When a rabbit sees an enemy, it runs into the hole. Its tail, which is white, bobs up and down when it runs. The other rabbits see it, they run too. They know that there is a danger. Similarly, a bee dances and lets other bees know that it has found food. Similarly, a dog barks when a stranger comes near.

sub_questions.i: How does a rabbit react when it sees an enemy?
sub_questions.ii: What do the other rabbits do?
sub_questions.iii: How does a bee let other bees know about food?

anuprashna.i: जब खरगोश किसी दुश्मन को देखता है तो वह कैसी प्रतिक्रिया देता है?
anuprashna.iii: एक मधुमक्खी दूसरी मधुमक्खियों को भोजन के बारे में कैसे बताती है?

2021.question: Read the poem carefully and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: कविता को ध्यान से पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2021.context:
I lay in sorrow deep distressed:
My grief a proud man heard
His looks were cold, he gave me gold
But not a kindly word
My sorrow passed I paid him back
The gold he gave to me,
Then stood erect and spoke my thanks
And blessed his charity

sub_questions.i: How was the speaker feeling when a proud man heard him?
sub_questions.ii: What did the proud man do?
sub_questions.iii: What did the speaker do after his sorrow passed?

anuprashna.i: जब एक घमंडी आदमी ने वक्ता को सुना तो वह कैसा महसूस कर रहा था?
anuprashna.iii: दुःख बीत जाने के बाद वक्ता ने क्या किया?

2021.question: OR Read the poem carefully and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: अथवा कविता को ध्यान से पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2021.context:
World you are beautifully drest
The wonderful air is over me,
And the wonderful wind is shaking the tree,
It walks on the water and whirls the mills,
And talks to itself on the tops of the hills.

sub_questions.iii: What talks to itself on the tops of the hills?

anuprashna.i: कौन खूबसूरती से सजा हुआ है?
anuprashna.iii: पहाड़ियों की चोटियों पर अपने आप से कौन बातें करता है?

2022.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow :
2022.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2022.context: Sharks have prowled the seas for about 400 million years. Their size, power and great toothy jaws fill us with fear and fascination. A few kinds of sharks such as great white sharks attack the swimmers but most of them stay away from people. Most of the sharks eat other sharks. Sharks are fish but they don't have bones. They are made up of rubbery bone material called cartilage. Sharks use their eyes, ears and sense of smell to hunt food.

sub_questions.i: For how many years sharks have prowled the seas ?
sub_questions.iii: What is a shark skeleton made up of ?

anuprashna.i: शार्क कितने वर्षों से समुद्रों में घूम रही हैं?
anuprashna.iii: शार्क का कंकाल किससे बना होता है?
anuprashna.iv: शार्क भोजन का शिकार कैसे करती हैं?

2022.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow : (OR)
2022.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें: (अथवा)
2022.context: Vitamins and minerals are natural substances found in a wide range of food and are essential to maintain a healthy body. Vitamin-A keeps eyes and skin healthy and helps to protect against infections. Vitamin-A is found in milk, eggs and vegetables. Vitamin-B is good for nervous system and is found in green vegetables. Vitamin-C helps the immune system by fighting against infections. Vitamin-C is found in citrus fruits like strawberries, kiwi, guava and tomatoes.

sub_questions.i: Where are vitamins and minerals found ?
sub_questions.ii: What are the sources of Vitamin A ?
sub_questions.iii: What is Vitamin B good for ?
sub_questions.iv: What does Vitamin C help in and what are its sources ?

anuprashna.i: विटामिन और खनिज कहाँ पाए जाते हैं?
anuprashna.ii: विटामिन A के स्रोत क्या हैं?
anuprashna.iii: विटामिन B किसके लिए अच्छा है?
anuprashna.iv: विटामिन C किसमें मदद करता है और इसके स्रोत क्या हैं?

2022.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow :
2022.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2022.context: Early rising is good for the mind and body. The great advantage of early rising is a good start of the day. In the morning hours, the mind is fresh and there are few sounds or other distractions. So the work done at that time is generally well done. Besides, an early riser also finds time to take some exercises in the fresh morning air. It supplies him with a lot of energy. An early riser has plenty of time to do his work. He also finds time for rest and recreation.

sub_questions.i: Who has plenty of time to do his work ?
sub_questions.ii: What is good for the mind and body ?
sub_questions.iii: When do you find few sounds or other distractions ?
sub_questions.iv: What supplies an early riser with a lot of energy ?

anuprashna.i: अपना काम करने के लिए किसके पास पर्याप्त समय होता है?
anuprashna.ii: मन और शरीर के लिए क्या अच्छा है?
anuprashna.iii: आपको कब कम आवाज़ें या अन्य विकर्षण मिलते हैं?
anuprashna.iv: जल्दी उठने वाले को भरपूर ऊर्जा किससे मिलती है?

2022.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow : (OR)
2022.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें: (अथवा)
2022.context: In a village lived two friends — Rohan and Sohan. Rohan was lame and Sohan was blind. One day, a hut in the village caught fire and it spread all over the village. People began running away. The two friends also wanted to escape but Rohan could not run but only limp and Sohan could not see. They were afraid. Just then Sohan had an idea. He was strong. He took Rohan on his shoulders. Then Rohan guided him where to go. Soon the friends walked to safety.

sub_questions.ii: What happened in the village one day ?
sub_questions.iii: Why were Rohan and Sohan sad and afraid ?
sub_questions.iv: How did the friends walk to safety ?

anuprashna.ii: एक दिन गाँव में क्या हुआ?
anuprashna.iii: रोहन और सोहन उदास और डरे हुए क्यों थे?
anuprashna.iv: दोस्त सुरक्षा की ओर कैसे बढ़े?

2022.question: Read the poem carefully and answer the questions that follow :
2022.prashna: कविता को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2022.context:
Sometimes I feel all thin inside
Insufficient ; small ;
I feel when people look at me
They don't see me at all.
I feel that all my beauty’s lost
On cold, indifferent eyes
And offering what I want to give
Would only be unwise
But then a friend will greet me
And my inner life will bloom
It only takes one kind word
To sweep away the gloom !

sub_questions.i: Why does the poet feel that people can’t see him ?
sub_questions.ii: What falls on cold, indifferent eyes ?

anuprashna.i: कवि को ऐसा क्यों लगता है कि लोग उसे देख नहीं पाते?
anuprashna.ii: ठंडी, उदासीन आँखों पर क्या गिरता है?
anuprashna.iii: उदासी को क्या दूर कर देता है?

2022.question: Read the poem carefully and answer the questions that follow : (OR)
2022.prashna: कविता को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें: (अथवा)
2022.context:
Live thy life,
Young and old
Like an oak
Bright in spring,
Living gold.
Summer rich
And then
Autumn — changed
Soberer — hued
Gold again.
All his leaves
Fall'n at length
Look, he stands,
Trunk and bough
Naked strength.

sub_questions.i: What looks like a living gold ? Why ?
sub_questions.ii: Why is the oak gold again ?
sub_questions.iii: What does the poet mean by ‘naked strength’ ?

anuprashna.i: जीवित सोने जैसा क्या दिखता है? क्यों?
anuprashna.ii: ओक फिर से सोना क्यों है?
anuprashna.iii: कवि का 'नग्न शक्ति' (naked strength) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
